text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire suffered a serious injury during
training, so I rushed her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, could this also be
a trial bestowed upon us by heaven?!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If I overcome every hardship, I will reach "that promised land."
Believing that, I have kept running all this way.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: However! If I am injured and cannot face the ultimate trial of the race in peak condition, the gates to the Otherworld might as well be closed...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Is this as far as I go...?
Am I fated to wither away in this world
without ever touching the world I dreamed of?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...No. Absolutely not!
Trials only come to those who have the strength to overcome them.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us brave this greatest of ordeals.
Beyond it, a beacon of light surely awaits!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now then, strike while the iron is hot!
Let us resume our training. Right this instant!
choice_data_list: No. You need absolute bed rest.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now then, strike while the iron is hot!
Let us resume our training. Right this instant!
choice_data_list: No. You need absolute bed rest.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Why is this happening!
Our contract to grant my dream,
was that all a lie!
choice_data_list: It's not a lie. Absolutely not.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Then why are you stopping me?
If I don't overcome this, I—
choice_data_list: Has taking on trials become the goal itself?
Has taking on trials become the goal itself?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The ordeal itself is the goal...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
B-But overcoming the trials
and reaching "that place" is my...—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"No, that was not the case.
My destiny is to bring salvation
as a Saint in 'that land.'"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "In that case, I cannot afford to fall here. I must not let impatience blind me, nor let the darkness seize my feet...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
My eyes are open now.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"For now, let us seal away our eager hearts.
For the sake of the true trial that will come one day—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Trainer-san.
You truly have a deep understanding of what it means to be a Saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Let us be on our—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
...No! It's nothing—
choice_data_list: Even so, that's asking for too much...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I am terribly sorry.
I shall take a short rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Realizing that any movement brought pain, Red Desire went straight into recuperation."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu*...――

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I'm holding back my power, but... somehow made it!
With this, it looks like we can keep walking toward the other world without stopping!
choice_data_list: Now that you understand that, we're done for today.
Now that you understand that, let's call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
I must give thanks for the good fortune of being able to continue training tomorrow.
